paragraphs: In the exercise base there is the class `Person`, which we are already quite familiar with. There is also an outline for the class `HealthStation`. Health station objects process people in different ways, they e.g. weigh and feed people. In this exercise we will construct a health station. The code of the Person class should not be modified in this exercise!
